repos_data.description: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a Free and Open-Source HTML5 Network Performance Estimation Tool Written in Vanilla Javascript and only uses built-in Web APIs like XMLHttpRequest (XHR), HTML, CSS, JS, & SVG. No Third-Party frameworks or libraries are Required. Started in 2011 and moved to OpenSpeedTest.com dedicated Project/Domain Name in 2013.
Free MCP server: subnet math, port and MAC lookups, DNS, DNSBL, TLS certificate inspection, public IP. The whatismynetip.com toolbox for your coding agent. No account, no telemetry.
